US Investigates Cyberattacks on Oil Tankers Bound for Texas

The U.S. Coast Guard and FBI boarded a commercial oil tanker bound for Texas to investigate a potential cyberattack. The U.S. has not yet attributed the incident to a specific actor. Iranian state media amplified the story in the weeks following the attack, according to CBS News.
